purpose: Distinct study/knowledge-work lifestyle photograph for the basic AI package
generation_mode: new image; no reference image supplied
prompt:
Create ONE new photorealistic premium lifestyle advertising photograph, landscape1536x1024,3:2 aspect ratio, clean bright white-warm natural daylight. Not a webpage or mockup. No reference-image imitation.
SUBJECT: a clearly ADULT Korean man in his LATE TWENTIES, a graduate student or thoughtful knowledge worker. Distinct mature calm appearance: short neatly cropped dark hair with tidy side part, thin round metal eyeglasses, gentle angular oval face, clean shaven, understated off-white/ivory knitted sweater. Fully clothed. He must look like an adult professional graduate student, not a teenage gaming model, no youthful fluffy gaming hairstyle, no headphones, no exaggerated grin.
ACTION: he studies material on a desktop monitor and writes thoughtful notes with a pen in an open notebook. One hand naturally holds the pen to paper while the other gently steadies the notebook; anatomically plausible fingers/hands. Calm absorbed expression, gaze alternates toward notebook/monitor, not directly at camera. A few tasteful unlabelled books and a small note sheet, no clutter.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITION: a fresh bright OVER-THE-SHOULDER-INSPIRED THREE-QUARTER composition, camera placed slightly behind his left shoulder and offset out toward the side, enough angle that his three-quarter face, round glasses and focused eyes remain visible as he turns a little toward his notes. Person centered toward RIGHT side. Avoid a flat frontal portrait and avoid a pure90-degree profile. Include a soft near-foreground shoulder/desk edge for depth, but do not obscure his face. Desktop monitor occupies LEFT side at a believable angle and notebook/pen are visible lower center. Full head with comfortable margin, waist-up seated figure, natural shoulders, face remains a clear secondary focal point alongside the work scene.
ENVIRONMENT: airy modern home-study or bright reading-room corner, white shelves with a few simple books, warm pale-wood desk, diffused large-window daylight and subtle sunlit highlights. Warm white/cream palette, restrained elegant advertising atmosphere, candid believable concentration. Medium-wide editorial photography, realistic skin/fabric textures, gentle background blur, no dramatic lighting or exaggerated effects.
MONITOR: simple generic document-review appearance using only unlabelled gray lines and soft panels, perhaps a muted abstract diagram; NO legible words, letters, numbers, logos or recognisable software branding. Notebook shows a few abstract pen strokes rather than readable text; books have plain blank spines.
ABSOLUTELY NO captions, Korean words, readable UI text, logos, brand marks, price/spec labels, watermark, AI-model notice, border/frame, website elements or promotional slogans. HTML will add any needed disclosure separately. Only the photo of this fictional adult studying with monitor and handwritten notes. New distinct face, no real-person likeness requested. One image,1536x1024 landscape.

qa.method: Generated image directly inspected, copied output opened with view_image, dimensions and SHA256 verified
observed: Clearly adult fictional Korean male, thin round glasses and off-white knitwear
Over-the-shoulder-inspired three-quarter composition with visible face
Monitor left, person central-right, notebook/pen and natural hand positions visible
Warm bright daylight, simple study setting, small set of books
No camera-facing smile; focused study gaze and distinct clothing/angle from earlier work/gaming scenes
No logo, watermark, readable monitor text or caption
limitations: Generated fictional person, not employee/student testimonial or real-person record
Handwritten notebook contains abstract small strokes, not verified readable content

scope: New image and provenance only; data.js mapping left to root; no additional code edits after ai.js handoff
